news-korea-econ.title: Democratic Socialists of America activists signed pledge to support, defend 'Chinese socialism'
news-korea-econ.description: People with self-described Democratic Socialists of America ties signed on to support a pro-China statement that extols "Chinese socialism."

news-korea-econ.title: Carville says one democratic socialist's 'lunacy of the highest level' policy could haunt swing state Dems
news-korea-econ.description: James Carville warns that democratic socialist candidates in Michigan and Wisconsin primaries could taint the entire Democratic Party's image nationally.
